pages.text: When the unfamiliar cut was completed, the result felt inevitable—as though I had remembered something rather than learned it. The sensation has remained with me. I have begun to think of it as $(thing)Insight$().

Insight belongs to me personally. New discoveries add to it; repetition does not. My current total is synchronized to the Insight display.$(br2)I cannot spend it at the Gem Cutter. It will matter later, when I find a way to organize these fragments into schools of magic.
pages.title: A Lasting Understanding
